## What the asset itself can do to you

## Why the headline numbers moved

The range tells the drawdown story: 150.20 down to 80.10 inside a year is a 47 percent peak-to-trough swing, so an owner of these shares must be able to sit through a third of the price disappearing without new information.

## The decisive metrics, read

The record carries no volatility series and no liquidity series - both are gaps a sizing engine must fill from its own data.

## What would change my mind

The one dated risk marker in the pack is the 2026-10-22 results date: the only scheduled event that can gap the price. Whatever is decided, the decision should name the price at which it is wrong (the low 80s stopped the fall twice this year).
